desc: Write a Python function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using memoization.
Draft a two-paragraph blog post announcing a new product feature to non-technical readers.
Given a CSV of monthly sales figures, compute the month-over-month growth rate and identify the month with the sharpest decline.
Fix a bug in a REST API where pagination returns duplicate rows across pages.
Rewrite a dense technical changelog entry into plain language suitable for public release notes.
Analyze a dataset of customer churn and report the three strongest predictors with rough confidence intervals.
Refactor a function with deeply nested if/else branches into a cleaner, more testable structure.
Write a short, persuasive product description for an e-commerce listing page.
